prompts.tradesman-workwear:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: exploratory realistic video-game character turnaround sheet, Request 19.
Scene/backdrop: seamless plain uniform mid-grey background, soft even neutral studio light, minimal soft contact shadows only.
Style/medium: highly realistic grounded character concept visualization, photographic material detail and natural adult human anatomy. Poor California city in 2046, almost identical to present-day real clothes. Practical, worn, lived-in, understated. Match the project's realistic contemporary civilian art direction. No anime or painterly stylization.
Composition/framing: one wide landscape sheet containing EXACTLY THREE views of THE SAME single person wearing the SAME outfit and backpack: a large straight-on front view at left, a large straight-on rear view in the middle, and a visibly smaller FULL-BODY view at right from a battle camera elevated 50 degrees above horizontal, seen from rear three-quarter so the pack and shoulders read from above. Front and back are the same scale, head-to-boot tips entirely visible, aligned ground line, generous margins. The small view is about half the height of the other views, naturally foreshortened, elevated camera rather than a standing side view. All three show relaxed neutral stance, arms slightly away from torso, relaxed ungloved hands and feet. The subject is repeated only to depict these views; no additional person, portrait, detail panel, object inset or loose backpack.
Readability: clear practical silhouette, believable garment volume; readable when reduced to a roughly 55-pixel-tall tactical character.
Backpack rules: worn on the back in EVERY view with plausible shoulder harness. A compact computer containing their artificial general intelligence (AGI) partner, the size of a small 18-litre hiking backpack, about 38-42 cm tall, confined to the upper back and ending at the waist. Visible heat vents and secured cable runs, no dangling hazards. No screen, face, glowing eyes, luminous panels or lights.
Text: none whatsoever. No captions, labels, signature, watermark, letters or numerals. No logos, emblems, brand marks, insignia or weapons. Avoid the enemy's white with black and red accent palette. Do not add armor, tactical combat kit, futuristic helmets, cyberpunk decoration or other future technology beyond the pack. All faces covered from nose through mouth; no visible mouth or nose. Hair, hands, body build still visible.
Subject/identity proposal: original Mexican-American man age 32, medium warm tan skin, short dense dark slightly curly hair with cropped sides, average-tall 178 cm, sturdy working build with broad shoulders, natural proportions rather than superhero muscle. Thick dark eyebrows visible above eyewear. Uncovered hands with warm tan skin. Remember these exact identity features for later outfits.
Look: heritage workwear. Faded tobacco-brown canvas chore coat with softened seams, a washed muted olive tee beneath, dusty dark olive duck work pants, worn medium-brown leather work boots. Only a few modest electrician tool-belt pieces: compact leather pliers sleeve and a small worn pouch; no full heavy belt or dangling clutter. His father's rectangular company patch is on the coat's chest, completely covered by a plain piece of dull beige tape so no symbol or writing is visible.
Mask: realistic unbranded slate-grey industrial half-face respirator covering nose and mouth, two modest low-profile filter cartridges; separate amber-tinted safety glasses with visible frames, unlit lenses. Hair uncovered.
His AI pack: neatly constructed compact olive textile shell on a charcoal metal frame, a simple rectangular silhouette with softened corners, clean horizontal side heat vents and a narrow rear vent section, properly protected computer internals; tidy sleeved dark cables clipped close to the frame, tiny brass connector details. Restrained contemporary utility design, professional wiring the owner installed himself. Shoulder harness dark olive. Pack's exact construction consistent across all three views.

Do not alter any other part of the sheet. Plain mid-grey background and soft even lighting remain. No text, titles, logos, marks, symbols, extra views, extra people or loose object insets. No glowing hardware or screens. Face remains covered. Photorealistic materials and natural human anatomy.
